explanation: The provenance-bound rerun b1_fig4_hardening_20260918 (commit 10235db, branch audit/b1-hardening) repeated the B1 Fig.4 benchmark of the legacy AI baseline (results/literature_reference, now results/baselines/b1_mavelli2015). Before deleting its trajectory/rates CSVs and figures, byte identity against the baseline was verified. Only the numerical CSVs are scientific evidence; they were byte-identical (SHA-256 below), so the copies were removed. The manifest.json, benchmark_summary.json and per-condition qc.json of the hardened run are kept as provenance evidence. The two PNG figures were re-rendered from identical trajectories but are NOT byte-identical (MATLAB embeds render-time metadata; identical pixel dimensions and byte sizes); they were removed as regenerable duplicates and the baseline figures remain in results/baselines/b1_mavelli2015/.
verification_method: SHA-256 of files on disk (hardening run vs legacy baseline) and of git blobs of the deleted files (git cat-file blob HEAD:results/b1_fig4_hardening_20260918/...)
